classificationRule.FRAGILE: Any transformation has synthetic recall retention <0.70 at the frozen SAFE threshold or negative FPR increase >0.05 versus the same selected originals.
classificationRule.MIXED: Otherwise any transformation has synthetic recall retention <0.90 or negative FPR increase >0.02.
classificationRule.ROBUST: All measured transformations satisfy the MIXED bounds.

applicabilityRule.HIGH: ORIGINAL or metadata-only strip with no measurable resampling/recompression indicator in the input lineage.
applicabilityRule.MODERATE: JPEG95/JPEG85, resize75, mild crop, mild blur or mild sharpen; measurable alteration exists but the regime remains within bounded stress coverage.
applicabilityRule.LOW: JPEG75, resize50 or screenshot-style resampling; strong recompression/resampling evidence limits SAFE authority.
applicabilityRule.UNSUPPORTED: Unknown or compounded transformation not represented by the frozen matrix; no synthetic conclusion from SAFE applicability alone.

productBoundary: Applicability changes the authority of SAFE evidence, never the authenticity truth label by itself.
